messages:
sam.sales: Prospect 'MerchantGate' sent a security questionnaire and asked for a short POC. Primary asks: SAML SSO, SCIM bulk + delta (~50k), RBAC (admin vs user roles), domain ownership verification, EU data residency, and Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Need owners + a 1-pg SOW.
kai_se: noted. Do they want Hosted first?
sam.sales: yes Hosted eval first, but they want a costed path to Dedicated if perf checks out. Procurement wants a pricing paragraph and SOW by EOD.
juna_eng: sizing guidance: for 50k users + 100 TPS bursts recommend 4xGPU reserved with 1.5x burst headroom. Ballpark commit range: ~$30k-$70k/mo depending on model family and quantization. Hosted POC (72h, SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) typically < $1k.
juna_eng: perf notes: prefix KV cache + batching to keep p95 low; offer quantized variants to reduce cost during pilot.
kai_se: SCIM pattern: full import then PATCH deltas. We can temporarily raise SCIM rate for POC with backoff guidance. Send mapping example.
kai_se: SCIM mapping snippet to send:
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"email","name":{"givenName":"firstName","familyName":"lastName"},"emails":[{"value":"email","type":"work"}],"groups":["roles"]}
```
frank_sec: security checklist: request completed questionnaire, IdP metadata (entityID, ACS, X509 cert), SCIM ops required (create/update/patch/delete), data classification (PII/payment data?), retention/audit windows, and HSM requirement. We'll provide SOC2 link, DPA template, redacted pen-test, and KMS/HSM options.
legal_ops: I'll handle DPA review once we have their legal POC.
sam.sales: action items: (1) request IdP metadata + 100-user CSV sample + legal POC, (2) Juna owns perf smoke, Kai owns integration, Frank to upload security pack.
poc_bot: ticket #POC-11422 created: MerchantGate POC  owners: juna_eng (infra), kai_se (integration), frank_sec (security). Link: https://redwood.internal/poc/POC-11422
sam.sales: I'll send the SOW + pricing blurb now. Please keep replies in this thread and flag blockers. :thumbsup:
